

## Demographics


MPX NYC participants were demographically diverse (see @tbl-demographics and @fig-racegender-radar-grid). Over half were aged 18–34. About two-fifths were white cisgender men, 15 percent Latinx cisgender men, 10 percent Black cisgender men. Roughly 5 percent were transgender (half trans men) and 7 percent non-binary. Two-thirds identified as gay, 14 percent bisexual, 12 percent queer. 

{{< include fig-sexorientation-racegender.qmd >}}

Patterns of sexual orientation varied sharply by gender. Most cis men identified as gay; trans men were most often queer; trans women were more often straight or bisexual; cis women were mostly straight, then bisexual, then queer; non-binary participants were mainly queer.
